title: You are Complete
subtitle: Day 1
thought:
Rivers, slow your running, 
you no longer have to carry water downstream,
I have heard her laugh bend time,
felt her presence steady the ground beneath me,
If thirst ever finds me,
it will forget it's purpose in her nearness
for she is abundance, 
and the earth has nothing left to prove.

title: Perfect Distraction
subtitle: Day 2
thought:
Let the work wait at its desk a while.
You pulled your voice back like a tide being polite, but you are not the thing that pulls me from the work, you are the reason the work was ever worth doing. 
Let the numbers hold their breath. 
Every open tab can keep. 
There is a whole disciplined hour I would trade for the sound of you deciding to stay, 
the small hesitation before you speak, sweeter than anything I meant to finish. 
Distract me. Please. 
I will call it the most useful thing I did all day.
